messages:
Priya: Quick sync — SOC2/ISO final-mile. Who's owning audit-log backfill and KMS/HSM handoff? Need owners for: audit-log backfill (ETL), HSM attestation docs, change-control approver, and CR review for kms-ingest PR. Target: complete by Fri EOD. cc @Jordan @Eli @Samir

Jordan: I'll take audit-log backfill ETL. Need DB read window and confirm retention window. Can someone add me to INF-logs-admins? :+1:

Eli: Assigned HSM attestation docs. Will draft playbook by tomorrow. Who's the approver for the playbook? @Maria security?

Maria: I can review the playbook but want a short walkthrough — placeholder 30m tomorrow. Also flag: infra team needs the key-wrap flow diagram updated for on-prem HSM.

Samir: I'll review kms-ingest PR #278. Ping me the link. Small heads up — CI is flaky on the integration test, I requeued once.

Priya: PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/kms-ingest/pulls/278 — Samir please do review. Jordan, I'll add you to INF-logs-admins now.

infra-bot: Ticket created INF-4312: "audit-log backfill: initial job & owner" — assignee: Jordan. https://tickets.redwood.ai/INF-4312

Jordan: got it, INF-4312 received. ETA for backfill job skeleton: Wed EOD, full backfill depends on retention window check. Need a list of indices from Observability team.

Priya: @Aaron can you export the index list and attach to INF-4312?

Aaron: I can export index list by tomorrow morning. Will attach to INF-4312.

Samir: quick question — for backfill, are we rerunning through the new parser? If yes, expect CPU spike and will need burst capacity from Dedicated pool.

Priya: Yes run through new parser v2.0. Samir can you coordinate with eng-infra for burst policy? Tagging @ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: noted, we have a temporary autoscale rule we can enable for the window. Need exact start/end times and estimate of QPS.

Jordan: estimate: 4 hours of heavy processing, 200 rps peak for 30m windows. I'll sketch schedule in INF-4312.

Eli: For HSM attestation docs — draft in /docs/security/hsm-attest-draft.md. PTAL; content includes key rotation checklist, audit commands:
```bash
./hsm-attest --export --sha256 > attest-2026-03-18.txt
```
Also note: KMS provider needs permission "kms:GenerateAttestation".

Maria: Reviewed draft; added comments on key custody section. Also we should add requirement for KMS/HSM access logs to be forwarded to audit-logs before cutover.

Samir: I left review comments on PR #278. Two tiny fixes + test flake note. Will request re-run after fixes.

Priya: Ops: can we confirm change control approver? We need sign-off for on-prem HSM configuration. @Claire from legal/security?

Claire: I can sign change control once I get the impact summary and rollback plan. Please file it under CHG-9821.

Jordan: Filing CHG-9821 now, linking INF-4312 and the HSM playbook.

Priya: Final ask — please update the milestone board: "Compliance final-mile" — blockers: index list, ops autoscale rule, change control, CR review. If we close those by Fri, we can lock fieldwork next week.

Eli: Will prep walkthrough tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:

Aaron: Index list uploaded to INF-4312. :white_check_mark:

Samir: Re-ran CI after fixing tests, all green. Approved PR #278. :rocket:

Jordan: Backfill skeleton submitted, need DB read session. Pinged DB team.

Priya: Thanks all. If problems arise, escalate in #incidents channel. Otherwise, standups tomorrow will capture status.
